plugin.note: Prime is the magic Dagannoth King and is killed with Ranged. Keep Protect from Magic active whenever Prime can attack; long-range weapons allow safer Prime-only or tribrid rotations.

requirements: Dagannoth task or Boss task where applicable for Slayer helmet bonuses
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock, a partner, or the 85 Agility shortcut to reach the Kings
70+ Ranged recommended for Prime-only; higher stats and switches for tribrid
Antipoison or serpentine helm for Spinolyp poison
Elite Fremennik Diary strongly recommended for noted Dagannoth bones
mechanics: Dagannoth Prime uses hard-hitting magical 3x3 area attacks and is weak to Ranged.
Protect from Magic should be active before entering and whenever Prime is attacking.
Dagannoth Rex uses melee and can be safespotted with Magic.
Dagannoth Supreme uses ranged and is killed with Melee.
Spinolyps around the island poison with ranged attacks and drain Prayer with magic hits.
A long-range Ranged weapon can reach Prime from the north while avoiding Rex and Supreme aggression ranges.

methods.label: Kings overview
methods.summary: Use Ranged for Prime, Magic for Rex, and Melee for Supreme while keeping Prime's magic damage controlled.
recommendedFor: Prime unique drops or pet hunting
steps: Keep Protect from Magic active whenever Prime can attack.
Attack Prime with Ranged from the north or east when safe.
Use Magic for Rex and Melee for Supreme if tribridding.
Use downtime between respawns to move safely and reduce overlap.

methods.label: Entering the lair
methods.summary: Enter with Protect from Magic active and move into a Prime-safe or tribrid starting position.
steps: Activate Protect from Magic before entering the lair.
If safespotting, enter and exit until the south-east route is clear of Prime and Supreme aggression.
Run to the eastern wall for Rex/Prime safe setups.
If Prime is not aggressive and Supreme is safe, begin with the target that best matches your rotation.
risks: Prime can kill quickly if Protect from Magic is not active.

methods.label: Handling multicombat
methods.summary: Camp Protect from Magic when overwhelmed, or off-tick prayers against multiple Kings when confident.
steps: Reduce the time spent with multiple Kings alive and able to reach you.
If several Kings attack, off-tick prayers where possible.
For a lower-effort response, keep Protect from Magic active and kill Supreme quickly or safespot Rex.
Use high-defence armour to tank Rex and Supreme when using strong gear.

methods.label: Tribrid safe rotation
methods.summary: Kill Rex from the east wall, Prime from the north wall with Ranged, and Supreme with Melee from the west/south side.
steps: Move counter-clockwise along the southern wall to the east side.
Safespot Rex with Magic.
Rotate north and kill Prime with Ranged from the northern wall.
Rotate south and kill Supreme with Melee while staying west.
Return east for the next Rex spawn.

methods.label: Tribrid fast rotation
methods.summary: Use high damage to kill Supreme, drag Rex to north-west safespot, then kill Prime from the north.
steps: Open on Supreme with Melee if Prime can be avoided or prayed against.
Drag Rex to the north-west safespot and kill it with Magic.
Move north and attack Prime with Ranged.
Continue Supreme, Rex, Prime cycles while avoiding respawn overlap.
risks: Requires enough damage to prevent sustained multi-King pressure.

methods.label: Rex-only safespot
methods.summary: Rex can be killed from the eastern wall with Magic if alternating Rex and Prime or recovering between Prime kills.
steps: Reach the eastern wall safely.
Attack Rex and move north or south until it catches on the eastern wall.
Kill Rex with Magic while preserving Protect from Magic awareness for Prime.

methods.label: Prime only
methods.summary: Range Prime from the north-east corner while remaining outside Supreme and Rex aggression.
steps: Set up in the north-east corner or eastern side.
Attack Prime with Ranged without entering Rex or Supreme aggression range.
Use Telekinetic Grab to collect unsafe drops.
Alternate with Rex if desired.
risks: Prime does not move to the player, so drop collection can be unsafe without Telekinetic Grab.

methods.label: Max tribrid inventory
methods.summary: High-end tribrid inventory with switches, SGS, Death Charge, boosts, antipoison/restores, emergency healing, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Mid-level tribrid inventory
methods.summary: Mid-level setup with fewer switches, optional Blood/Ice spell runes, boosts, restores, food, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Rune pouch for Blood spells and optional Ice spells
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Rex safespot inventory
methods.summary: Rex-only setup uses Magic, antipoison, prayer, food, teleport, route items, and optional Guthan's sustain.
inventory: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Early Ironman Rex inventory
methods.summary: Early Rex trips use Iban's staff, tank gear, antipoison, a few prayer potions, teleport, route items, and food.

methods.label: Tips and tricks
methods.summary: Use cannon timing, Waterbirth portal, sustain gear, antipoison, diary, and shortcuts to extend trips.
notes: Use a dwarf multicannon with 1,000-2,000 cannonballs on Prime's spawn and only load it when Prime spawns.
Attune a house portal to Waterbirth.
Guthan's and Saradomin godsword reduce food use.
Ice Barrage can freeze Rex and Blood spells can heal.
Bring antipoison or wear serpentine helm.
Elite Fremennik Diary notes Dagannoth bones.
The 85 Agility shortcut, or 80 with Summer pie, skips rune thrownaxe and pet rock.

# Dagannoth Prime

Full Dagannoth Kings strategy source with entering, multicombat handling, tribrid rotations, Rex-only, Prime-only, inventories, and trip optimisations. Prime itself is killed with Ranged.
